svg.text: 42-key unibody choc Corne · nice!nano v2 · TPS43 trackpad · nice!view · 6×7 matrix, diodes col2row
Key positions and angles measured from cad/unicorne-choc-42-plate.step (19 mm pitch). Viewed from the top.
#n = keymap position · labels show the DEF layer · cyan = TPS43, pink = nice!view (optional), amber = powers both · dotted lines = column wires · glowing lines = row wires
